copy.curiosityHook: A defiant, streetwise young woman seems to hold crucial clues about the disappearance, but she is telling only part of what she knows.
copy.description: When an American doctor's wife suddenly vanishes from their Paris hotel room, he is thrust into an unfamiliar city, battling language barriers, indifferent police, and bureaucratic delays to find her.
copy.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful mystery of foreign displacement, demanding engaged focus without crushing emotional weight.
copy.whyWatch: Roman Polanski directs a taut neo-noir mystery where an ordinary man faces foreign isolation and tightening suspense across an unhelpful Paris.
